components.name: Primary Button
components.description: App Store download CTA; inverted text/background from theme tokens.
components.html: Download on the App Store
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 14px 22px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #1D1D1F; color: #F2F2F7; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.92; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2B62D9; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navbar Glass
components.description: Fixed top pill navigation with blur and download chip.
components.css: .ds-nav { position: fixed; top: 16px; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 50; display: flex; justify-content: center; padding: 0 20px; } .ds-nav-inner { width: 100%; max-width: 1080px; height: 56px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.72), rgba(255,255,255,0.48)); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.55); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px -8px rgba(29,29,31,0.08); backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(160%); } .ds-nav-brand { font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #1D1D1F; } .ds-nav-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #1D1D1F; color: #F2F2F7; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; }

components.name: Feature Spotlight Card
components.description: Two-column feature block with product screenshot and copy.
components.html:
Private life library

Photos, ratings, and notes stay on your device.
components.css: .ds-spotlight { display: grid; gap: 32px; padding: 40px 48px; border-radius: 28px; background: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px -8px rgba(29,29,31,0.08); } .ds-spotlight h3 { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.03em; margin-bottom: 16px; color: #1D1D1F; } .ds-spotlight p { font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.6; color: rgba(29,29,31,0.68); max-width: 42ch; }

narrative.overview: Apple-native marketing surface for a private life-library app. Calm system typography, glass navigation, and real product screenshots. The site persuades through privacy and taste—not growth hacks or social proof.
keyCharacteristics: WCAG AA contrast and 44px touch targets

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue accent on links, focus, and signature lines only—not every heading.

rules.name: The Flat Card Rule
rules.body: Do not stack border and large shadow on the same card.

dos: Use semantic CSS variables for theme-aware color
Keep en / zh-Hans / zh-Hant copy and aria-labels in sync
Run optimize-images.py and build-js.sh after asset or JS changes
donts: Imply Android or server access to user library data
Use gradient text or metric-stat hero templates
